sketches.mechanism: Ownership moves values into functions, and a moved value cannot be used again unless it implements Copy or is borrowed.
sketches.resonance: What is truly given leaves the giver unable to touch the same thing afterward.

sketches.mechanism: Non-strict evaluation does not evaluate an argument unless its value is demanded, so undefined can be passed safely to const.
sketches.resonance: An absence can remain in the room as long as no one asks it to answer.

sketches.mechanism: Limited types cannot be copied or assigned, so initializing one object from another of the same limited type is illegal.
sketches.resonance: Some memories may be carried, but never duplicated.
